clock: T = frame.frame.anchor_state_time_s (replay frame grid == unique D9 state_time_s grid)
rule: lap (driver, lap_number) visible iff its D9 row state_time_s (observed_at_s) <= T
joint_reveal: lap_time_s, sector_1_s, sector_2_s, sector_3_s become visible together at the lap observation boundary; no partial-sector exposure
tie_break: equal observed_at_s orders by lap_number ascending (covers the single 2021-r08-R stroll laps-4/5 restart tie)
in_progress: current lap = maxCompletedLap + 1 shown with number only; final values unavailable, never estimated
in_progress_gate: shown only while replay advances (not final frame) and driver is within one lap of the leader; otherwise explicit unavailable state
scoping: selectedDriverId only; driver switches re-slice the cached race corpus locally
missing: null stays null, rendered as em-dash, never zero-filled
